Name: Get user by username
Description: Returns a public Sleeper user object.
Budget Bowl Use: Link a Budget Bowl account to a Sleeper identity.
Caching Guidance: Cache user_id permanently; refresh mutable profile fields periodically.

Name: Get user by user ID
Description: Returns a public Sleeper user object by stable ID.
Budget Bowl Use: Refresh linked account identity and avatar.
Caching Guidance: Cache for several hours or daily.

Name: Get full-size avatar
Description: Returns the full-size avatar image for a user or league.
Budget Bowl Use: Display Sleeper user and league avatars.
Caching Guidance: Cache through an image/CDN layer using the avatar ID.

Name: Get avatar thumbnail
Description: Returns a thumbnail avatar image.
Budget Bowl Use: Compact roster and league displays.
Caching Guidance: Cache through an image/CDN layer using the avatar ID.

Name: Get leagues for user
Description: Returns all leagues for a user, sport and season.
Budget Bowl Use: League import and league-selection screens.
Caching Guidance: Refresh on login and on explicit sync.

Name: Get league
Description: Returns league settings, scoring, roster positions and season links.
Budget Bowl Use: Core league configuration and commissioner verification.
Caching Guidance: Refresh periodically and before configuration-dependent operations.

Name: Get league rosters
Description: Returns rosters, owners, players, starters and standings settings.
Budget Bowl Use: Roster synchronization, team ownership and standings.
Caching Guidance: Refresh on sync; more often during waivers and games.

Name: Get league users
Description: Returns league users, display names, avatars, team metadata and commissioner flag.
Budget Bowl Use: Manager directory and commissioner authorization.
Caching Guidance: Refresh daily or on explicit sync.

Name: Get weekly matchups
Description: Returns every roster's players, starters, matchup ID and league-scored points for a week.
Budget Bowl Use: Scoreboards, lineup history and weekly results.
Caching Guidance: Refresh frequently during active games; freeze completed weeks locally.

Name: Get winners bracket
Description: Returns playoff winners-bracket matchups and progression.
Budget Bowl Use: Playoff display and league history.
Caching Guidance: Refresh during playoffs; retain completed bracket.

Name: Get losers bracket
Description: Returns playoff consolation/losers-bracket matchups and progression.
Budget Bowl Use: Consolation standings and draft-order workflows.
Caching Guidance: Refresh during playoffs; retain completed bracket.

Name: Get transactions by round/week
Description: Returns trades, waivers and free-agent transactions for a round (NFL week).
Budget Bowl Use: Contract transaction synchronization and audit history.
Caching Guidance: Poll incrementally; store transaction_id idempotently.

Name: Get league traded picks
Description: Returns current ownership of traded future picks.
Budget Bowl Use: Asset ownership, trade validation and draft-pick displays.
Caching Guidance: Refresh after transactions and before trade validation.

Name: Get sport state
Description: Returns current season, week, display week and league-season state.
Budget Bowl Use: Choose default season/week and drive scheduled synchronization.
Caching Guidance: Cache briefly; refresh before time-sensitive jobs.

Name: Get drafts for user
Description: Returns all drafts for a user in a season.
Budget Bowl Use: User draft history and draft selection.
Caching Guidance: Refresh on demand.

Name: Get drafts for league
Description: Returns all drafts for a league; dynasty leagues may have multiple.
Budget Bowl Use: Identify rookie, startup and supplemental drafts.
Caching Guidance: Refresh on league sync.

Name: Get draft
Description: Returns draft settings, status, order and roster-slot mapping.
Budget Bowl Use: Draft-board setup and ownership mapping.
Caching Guidance: Poll during live drafts; retain completed draft metadata.

Name: Get draft picks
Description: Returns all completed selections in a draft.
Budget Bowl Use: Draft import, rookie-contract creation and auction recap.
Caching Guidance: Poll during live drafts; freeze completed results.

Name: Get draft traded picks
Description: Returns traded-pick ownership associated with a draft.
Budget Bowl Use: Draft-board ownership and asset validation.
Caching Guidance: Refresh with the draft and after trades.

Name: Get all players
Description: Returns the player-ID map; optional filters limit by fantasy position and active status.
Budget Bowl Use: Canonical Sleeper player IDs and external-ID crosswalks.
Caching Guidance: Sleeper says no more than once daily; filtered requests may be smaller.

Name: Get trending adds
Description: Returns players with the most adds during the selected lookback.
Budget Bowl Use: Waiver trends and market-demand signals.
Caching Guidance: Cache for 15-60 minutes and attribute Sleeper.

Name: Get trending drops
Description: Returns players with the most drops during the selected lookback.
Budget Bowl Use: Drop alerts and declining-demand indicators.
Caching Guidance: Cache for 15-60 minutes and attribute Sleeper.

Name: Get season projections
Description: Returns projected season stat lines, ranks and generic fantasy-point fields.
Budget Bowl Use: Custom-scoring season forecasts and contract-value analysis.
Caching Guidance: Snapshot daily; preserve previous valid response.

Name: Get weekly projections
Description: Returns projected weekly stat lines, ranks and fantasy-point fields.
Budget Bowl Use: Weekly lineup context and player/trade comparisons.
Caching Guidance: Refresh several times weekly in season; validate schema.

Name: Get player projections grouped by week
Description: Returns a player's projection records, optionally grouped by week.
Budget Bowl Use: Player-page projection trend and remaining schedule outlook.
Caching Guidance: Cache with the bulk projection feed where possible.

Name: Get season player-stat leaderboard
Description: Returns season statistics and generic fantasy ranks/points across players.
Budget Bowl Use: Production rankings, cost per point and player search filters.
Caching Guidance: Refresh after games and correction windows.

Name: Get weekly player statistics
Description: Returns player statistics for a selected week.
Budget Bowl Use: Weekly stat import and custom-scoring calculations.
Caching Guidance: Refresh during/after games; retain completed snapshots.

Name: Get player statistics
Description: Returns season totals or week-grouped statistics for one player.
Budget Bowl Use: Player histories, recent form, cost per snap and custom scoring.
Caching Guidance: Prefer bulk ingestion; use targeted calls for repairs.

Name: Get player research rates
Description: Returns player-ID keyed owned and started rates observed by Sleeper.
Budget Bowl Use: Sleeper roster/start-rate market indicators.
Caching Guidance: Refresh weekly; label methodology conservatively.

Name: Get individual player details
Description: Returns targeted metadata for one NFL player.
Budget Bowl Use: Repair or refresh a player without downloading the full map.
Caching Guidance: Use sparingly; keep the documented daily map as primary.

Name: Get team depth chart
Description: Returns player IDs grouped by offensive, defensive and special-teams depth-chart positions.
Budget Bowl Use: Starter/backup context, opportunity alerts and filters.
Caching Guidance: Refresh daily; treat as informational rather than official.

Name: Get regular-season schedule
Description: Returns game status, date, home, away, week and game ID.
Budget Bowl Use: Bye weeks, opponents, game association and lock support.
Caching Guidance: Refresh daily; store resolved kickoff/lock values locally.

Name: Get postseason schedule
Description: Returns postseason game schedule and IDs.
Budget Bowl Use: Playoff matchup context and game association.
Caching Guidance: Refresh during playoffs; retain final schedule.

Name: Get player news
Query / Body Parameters: GraphQL operation: get_player_news; variables/arguments include sport, player_id and limit
Description: Returns recent player-news metadata and source information.
Budget Bowl Use: News alerts, trade context and player-page briefings.
Caching Guidance: Cache results; link to sources; review content licensing.

Name: Get league-history metadata
Description: Returns Sleeper-stored league-history metadata such as observed standings summaries.
Budget Bowl Use: Optional history validation and historical enrichment.
Caching Guidance: Prefer reconstructing history from documented endpoints.
